title: Business information
intro: Save confirmed business facts for upcoming AI features. Chat suggestions are not available yet.
emptyHint: You haven't added business information yet. Enter the facts you want AI to use; anything missing should be checked with a person.
readonlyHint: You can view this information, but you cannot edit it.
name: Business name
nameHint: The name you use when replying to customers.
descriptionHint: Briefly describe what you offer and who you serve.
descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Bicycle sales and repairs for urban cycling.
hoursHint: Choose how you serve customers each day. You can add more than one period.
hoursPlaceholder: E.g. Monday–Friday, 9 am–6 pm. Saturday, 9 am–1 pm.
locationHint: Describe where you serve customers or how far your service reaches.
locationPlaceholder: E.g. In-store service. We do not ship.
servicesHint: Include only what you can offer. This does not confirm stock availability.
policiesHint: Explain how you handle quotes, bookings, deliveries or returns.
policiesPlaceholder: E.g. Quotes are confirmed after inspecting the product.
faqHint: Choose common questions and complete your business answers. You can also write your own questions.
faqPlaceholder:
Question: Do I need to book?
Answer: ...
limitsHint: Include only confirmed facts. Do not enter keys, access codes or customers’ personal data.
saveFailed: We couldn't save. Your changes are preserved so you can try again.
contentRequired: Describe the business or add service information.
retryHint: Try again to open the editor.
readFailed: We couldn't load the business information.
deniedTitle: You don't have permission to view this information
conflictMessage: Another administrator saved changes. Review the current information before saving again.
reviewHint: Compare the information. Keeping your changes prepares a new draft; it does not save it yet.
merged: We added the current information and kept the fields you edited. Review them before saving.
adopted: The editor shows the currently saved information.
uncertainMessage: We couldn't confirm the save. Review it before saving again or discarding.
uncertainHint: Your changes are preserved. First check the result of this save.
unresolvedMessage: The save is still unconfirmed. Your changes are preserved; you can review it again.
discardHint: Changes made since the last save will be lost.
uncertainLeaveHint: Your draft and recovery identifier will be lost. The save result will remain unconfirmed.
missingReceipt: The receipt was not found. This does not prove the save failed. Check again or retry the exact same request.
savedThenChanged: Your save was confirmed. The editor shows later changes by another administrator.
noPoint: You haven't chosen a point yet
referencePlaceholder: E.g. Entrance on the side street.
locationLinkHint: Generated when you choose a point. You'll be able to share it through WhatsApp later.
noExceptions: No exceptions added. Check holiday hours with the business.
question: Question

presets.payment: Which payment methods do you accept?
presets.quote: How can I request a quote?

hourErrors.incomplete: Choose an opening and closing time for every slot.
hourErrors.order: Closing must be after opening. If it crosses midnight, select “Closes the following day”.
hourErrors.overlap: Time slots overlap. Also check those that close the following day.
hourErrors.datesInvalid: Review special dates: they must be unique, with up to 32 allowed.

coordinatesHint: Enter both valid coordinates to prepare the link.
coordinatesInvalid: Review the latitude and longitude of the selected point.
locationInvalid: Use up to 500 characters for each location field.
pointHint: Navigate the map and select the place, or enter its coordinates. Confirm prepares the draft; Save commits the changes.
mapLabel: Map to choose the business location
mapUnavailable: We couldn't load the map. You can enter the coordinates and confirm the point.
addressHint: Enter your confirmed address before choosing the place. Changing it clears the selection for review.
legacyHint: Previously saved text. Keep anything still valid and review it while completing the new options; it is not converted automatically.
timeZoneHint: Opening hours and special dates use this time zone; this does not change general settings.
noQuestions: You haven't added any frequently asked questions yet.
faqInvalid: Enter every question and respect the limits: 20 questions, 200 characters per question and 1000 per answer.
specialTitle: Opening hours for a special date
specialHint: This date replaces weekly opening hours. Review periods that cross midnight.
faqSafety: Questions without answers won't be used to suggest messages.
searchPlaceHint: Enter the name and city. Choose a suggestion and open its listing to check the place.
noPlaces: No places found. Try adding the city.
placeWait: You can search again in {{seconds}} s.
placeConfigurationError: Search needs a valid Google Places server key. Review its API configuration.
placeLinkHint: Choosing prepares the draft. Save confirms the location; the link opens its complete Google Maps listing.
noPlaceChosen: You have not chosen a place yet.
